maya: FYI — customer reported a 403 on /v1/generate but UI shows 'invalid API key'. Customer insists key works for embeddings but fails for text generation. Request attached from customer (redacted). Can eng take a look? :thinking:

maya: Customer says their org recently migrated plans last week. They shared this curl: 
```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -H \"X-Account-Plan: starter\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-large\",\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'\n```
Response: 403 {"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"Key not found"} 

liam: I can take it. First guess: entitlement gating returning DENY but gateway mapping to generic 'invalid_api_key'. We had that mapping in 2023 for legacy clients.

liam: Can you paste the Gateway logs for the request id? We need the entitlement decision and the plan header from proxy.

maya: Pasting proxy trace (sanitized):
```
[2025-06-10T14:23:45Z] req=abc123 method=POST path=/v1/generate auth=sk-prod-REDACTED header.X-Account-Plan=starter
[2025-06-10T14:23:45Z] ent-check user=acct-999 decision=DENY gate=quota_or_feature gate_detail=feature:structured-output required_plan=pro
[2025-06-10T14:23:45Z] gateway resp=403 code=routing.invalid_key message=invalid_api_key
```

liam: OK that's the repro. Entitlement service denied because the model requires 'pro' (feature flag structured-output). The gateway currently maps any entitlement DENY -> invalid_key for older clients; bad UX.

ashley: From billing: acct-999 was on Starter until yesterday, migration to Pro started but webhook failed to update entitlement flag in our billing-cache. So edge case: payment succeeded but cache still 'starter'.

maya: Customer timeline: they paid, portal shows Pro, but API calls still hit Starter in backend. They see invalid key which caused them to file tickets.

devex-tim: We should do two things: 1) stop masking entitlement DENY as invalid_api_key; surface reason (plan_restriction) + gate name, 2) add a short-term remediation: gateway should, when entitlement DENY but auth token valid, return 403 with code=plan_restricted and message that suggests contacting billing or checking plan.

liam: Agree. For immediate patch I can change mapping in gateway: entitlement.DENY -> {code: plan_restricted, message: \"plan does not allow model/feature\"} and include gate=structured-output. That preserves 403 but removes 'invalid key' noise.

liam: Repro steps I used locally: 1) create test acct with starter plan 2) call /v1/generate for model requiring structured-output 3) observe entitlement.DENY in entitlement logs and gateway response code=routing.invalid_key.

liam: Minimal patch diff (gateway):
```diff
- if (entitlement == DENY) return invalid_key_resp;
+ if (entitlement == DENY && auth_valid) return plan_restricted_resp;
```

maya: Ticketed a customer-facing follow-up and apologized. Asked for ETA to hotfix + rollback plan if needed.

liam: I'll push a hotfix to staging now, then to prod (canary) in us-west-2 only. ops-bot will post deploy status.

ops-bot: deploy started: gateway-hotfix/ent-mask-2025 by liam -> staging -> canary us-west-2

ops-bot: canary deploy success (2/2 nodes) at 2025-06-10T15:02:17Z

liam: Canary looks clean. I added extra log fields: entitlement_reason and gate_name (redacted in customer logs).

liam: Plan for next week: 1) update gateway mapping globally, 2) add integration tests for entitlement->error mapping, 3) update SDKs/docs to show new error code 'plan_restricted' and link to console. I opened PR #3198.

ashley: Billing will add a reconciliation job to re-sync migrated accounts; we found 14 accounts stuck in cache. We'll prioritize the one that reported this.

maya: Customer notified; we offered a one-day credit and confirmed the fix rolling out. They validated it once we flipped the canary. :thumbsup:

devex-tim: Follow-ups for product/console: expose plan change state in account details (pending/cached/synced) and a clear error callout for 403/plan_restricted so support can triage faster.

maya: Adding notes for KB update: \"403 shows 'invalid_api_key' but may indicate plan gating — check entitlement logs and billing-cache sync\". I'll craft a short triage checklist.

liam: Closing loop: root cause = billing-cache lag + gateway mapping that masked entitlement denies as auth failures. Fix deployed to canary; global rollout pending after CI. ETA for global = ~48 hours.

maya: Thanks all — I'll keep the thread updated and close after global rollout.
